title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version replaces the previous raw workbench-style file surface with a curated reader-facing surface: cumulative reader PDFs, forty-three standalone English paper PDFs, and compact language/source ZIPs.

Current reader files. German/source cumulative: current RA20 Paper 02 display-fix branch. English cumulative: current RA10 apparatus-restoration branch. Spanish and Japanese: RA10 cumulative working branches. French and Simplified Chinese: checkpoint streams through Paper 19 section 6, not complete 43-paper corpora.

Compact packages. The language ZIPs contain the corresponding TeX/source material and concise ledgers. Raw session/audit bundles are intentionally omitted from this public surface unless distilled into reader files or short status ledgers; older Zenodo versions preserve earlier raw/provenance-heavy uploads.

Known open items. RA20 fixes German/source Paper 02 p.63 display layout; non-German propagation remains queued. RA10 restores scan-visible apparatus for Papers 40-43 but leaves inline body resynchronization open. The French/Simplified Chinese checkpoint applies a Paper 19 section 6 tau-exponent correction to DE/FR/ZH; EN/ES/JA propagation remains queued.

Corrections and collaboration. Public working mirror and issue/pull-request surface: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Curated reader-facing Noether surface: cumulative reader PDFs, 43 standalone English paper PDFs, and compact language/source ZIPs. Raw session/audit bundle sprawl is omitted from this version; known correction streams and open propagation items are stated explicitly.
